admin.title: Game management
admin.unreadableArchive: Cannot read the game archive. Check its ZIP format, paths and size.
admin.processingConfiguration: The game configuration is being processed. Please wait.
admin.description: Manage the shared library. Configuration changes preserve existing progress; deletions show their impact before confirmation.
admin.reuseHelp: Reuse the files already on the server. Renaming or changing the editor association keeps the release; launch or synchronization changes create a new release and preserve existing progress.
admin.editorUnavailable: No save editor is available for this platform yet.
admin.editorHelp: You can link an editor later. An administrator selects the appropriate editor.
admin.discHelp: Upload a ZIP up to 1 GiB containing one CUE and every referenced BIN track. Multiple BIN files are supported and filename case is normalized. Multi-disc games, CHD and WAV/MP3 tracks are not supported yet.
admin.fileHelp: Maximum 64 MiB per file. Use ZIP or jsdos for DOS, and uncompressed ROMs for consoles.
admin.legacyLaunchHelp: This archive has a complex launch script. Leave the executable empty to preserve it. Selecting an executable replaces the script and creates a new release.
admin.cyclesHelp: Use auto, max or 1–999999. For multiple launch commands, select a BAT file containing them.
admin.savePathsExample: One path per line, such as SAVE.DAT or GAME/slots/index.dat
admin.savePathsHelp: Paths are relative to the archive root; use / for subdirectories. Multiple files are supported, but wildcards are not. Matching saves are removed from the archive; remove other personal saves and unrelated files before uploading. Leaving this empty disables automatic change detection; manual saving remains available.
admin.consoleSaveHelp: The emulator adapter manages console saves and snapshots. No file paths are needed.
admin.pendingCleanup: Progress for these games has been deleted, but disk cleanup is incomplete:
admin.versionHelp: DOS launch and synchronization settings belong to each release. Editing reuses existing files; existing progress is not migrated or overwritten. Enable an editor only for a verified game version.
admin.fileSize: The game file must not exceed {maximum} MiB.
admin.reconfigured: Published a new release of {title} using the existing files. Earlier releases and progress are retained. {association}
admin.published: Published {title}. Return to the library to play. {removed}
admin.firmwareRegion: Current BIOS region: {region}. Keep it by default, or select the shared BIOS to publish a new release using the stored disc. Existing progress stays on the original release.
quota.title: Save storage limits
quota.used: In use: {bytes} across {count} versions. Host disk reserve: {reserve}.
quota.help: New limits take effect immediately. Saves that exceed a limit are refused.
quota.changed: Another administrator updated the limits. Reload them before saving.
